questions.prompt: Where does the system prompt go in the request format DeepSeek uses?
options: In a separate system field at the top of the body
questions.explanation: In this format the system prompt has its own system field. The messages list holds only user and assistant messages.

questions.prompt: You put an assistant message in the request that the model never wrote. What does the model do with it?
options: It treats it as its own earlier answer, because a role is only a label in the text
It rejects the request, because it remembers its real answers
It treats it as the system prompt
questions.explanation: The model keeps no record of what it said. It reads the role label and treats the text as its own earlier answer.

questions.prompt: Why does "And of Italy?" get the answer "The capital of Italy is Rome."?
options: The model looks up Italy in a database of capitals
The earlier messages in the same request set the topic and the pattern of the answer
The API key stores the earlier question
questions.explanation: The question alone is unclear. The earlier user and assistant messages in the same request give the topic, capitals, and the sentence pattern to follow.
